# QA Test Plan Template

Use this template to create a focused test plan for a release or feature.

## 1. Overview
- Project / Feature:
- QA Lead:
- Testers:
- Test environments:

## 2. Scope
- In-scope:
- Out-of-scope:

## 3. Test Strategy
- Types of testing (unit, integration, system, regression, performance, security)
- Automation approach and scope
- Test data needs

## 4. Entry / Exit Criteria
- Entry criteria (what must be in place to start testing)
- Exit criteria (conditions to consider testing complete)

## 5. Test Execution
- Test schedule and milestones
- Test case mapping (link to test case repository or tracking tool)
- Defect triage process and severity definitions

## 6. Environment & Dependencies
- Environments required (dev, test, staging, prod)
- Dependencies on other teams or services

## 7. Reporting
- Test status reporting cadence
- Quality metrics to track

## 8. Risks & Mitigations
- Known risks and planned mitigations
